brief:
Palestinian activist Mahmoud Khalil returned to Columbia University for the first time since his detention by US authorities, Al Jazeera English reported. The activist had been held in custody before his release, which allowed him to resume his presence on campus.

Khalil's return comes as pro-Palestinian student activism continues at the university, where demonstrations around the Israeli-Palestinian conflict have remained a fixture in recent months.
dek: Pro-Palestinian activist Mahmoud Khalil returned to Columbia University for the first time since his US detention.
title: Palestinian activist Mahmoud Khalil returns to Columbia after US detention
